final: WITH telescope_averages AS (SELECT t.telescregistry, t.equipstatus, AVG(s.pulsepersec) AS pulse_avg FROM telescopes AS t JOIN signals AS s ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry GROUP BY t.telescregistry, t.equipstatus), status_averages AS (SELECT equipstatus, AVG(pulse_avg) AS status_avg FROM telescope_averages GROUP BY equipstatus), first_mean AS (SELECT AVG(status_avg) AS mean_avg FROM status_averages), first_kept AS (SELECT sa.status_avg, sa.status_avg - fm.mean_avg AS first_excess FROM status_averages AS sa CROSS JOIN first_mean AS fm WHERE sa.status_avg > fm.mean_avg), second_mean AS (SELECT AVG(status_avg) AS mean_avg FROM first_kept) SELECT AVG(fk.status_avg) AS average_pulse_rate, AVG(fk.first_excess) AS average_excess_over_first_mean, AVG(fk.status_avg - sm.mean_avg) AS average_excess_over_second_mean FROM first_kept AS fk CROSS JOIN second_mean AS sm WHERE fk.status_avg > sm.mean_avg
